Mike wins again! I've ordered Sarrs from all over the place, and Mike's prices and quality are the pinnacle. I recently ordered 5 rhizomes, and he threw in two extras for free! Do not hesitate to order from Mike. He's incredibly nice and prompt with correspondence and shipping.

I ordered:

S. flava var. cuprea ‘best clone’
S. flava var. ornata 'improved black veins'
S. leucophylla Baldwin Co, AL ‘Alabama clone’
S. psittacina var. okefenokeensis f. luteoviridis Gulf Co, FL
S. white Mitchelliana x leucophylla hurricane creek white, clone F

And also received extra (both of substantial med-large size):

S. flava var. rugelii 'Giant', Eastern AL
S. minor var. okefenokeensis, Charlton Co, GA

I can't wait to see how they'll all show off in the spring!!!

Eric

    You can't go wrong ordering from Mike and for that matter any of the guys here.
